SUBSTITUTE PROJECT NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE 1 REZONING
6410 S. HONORE ST.

The Applicant is proposing a Zoning Map Amendment from the RS3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached
House) District to the B2-1, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

The Applicant proposes to renovate and convert an existing 2-story brick multi-unit residence and build a
1- and 2-story rear addition, for use as a community center. When completed, the building floor area will
be 3,955 sq. ft. The building height will be 30’-2”. The site is a Transit Served Location, approximately
798° from the 63rd Street bus.

The Applicant also seeks Type-I Application Relief pursuant to section 17-13-030-D of the Chicago
Zoning Ordinance for an Administrative Adjustment under section 17-13-1003-EE to reduce one (1)
required automobile parking space to zero (0) for properties located at Transit Served Locations.

Proposed Zoning: B2-1, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.
